charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Page canvas, primary background, inverted sections

onyx.$description: Onyx — Deepest darks, shadows, text on light surfaces

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text, inverted surfaces, light icons

iron.$description: Iron — Elevated card surface, image-adjacent panels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

fog.$description: Fog — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels

mist.$description: Mist — Light hairline borders, high-contrast meta text on dark

signal-mint.$description: Signal Mint — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Most Popular section card background, ranked-list emphasis

heat-red.$description: Heat Red — Podcasts section card background, audio content emphasis

forest.$description: Forest — Secondary green accent for category labels and subdued highlights

manuka.$description: Display headlines for hero and feature stories — ultra-heavy, near-zero leading creates editorial impact at the largest scale

poly-sans.$description: Primary UI font — nav, section headers, list items, card titles; tracks wide at small sizes (0.06–0.15em) for ALL-CAPS labels and tight at body sizes

fk-roman-standard.$description: Article body text — serif distinguishes reading mode from navigation; slight negative tracking tightens running text

poly-sans-mono.$description: Metadata, category tags, timestamps — monospaced feel with wide letter-spacing (0.10–0.125em) for technical/journalistic texture

ui-sans-serif.$description: System fallback for non-critical UI copy
